Three seasonal splash scenes for Arctic
extension.description: Fuji, Japanese countryside and Tokyo street artwork with four seasons, hourly lighting, weather effects and native skin animation recipes. Shared lossless transparency masks and mixed WebP compression keep the complete resource below 100 MB. Requires a skin implementing the version 2 diffuse-mask contract.

extension.summary: Japanese weather artwork for Arctic
extension.description: Japanese weather cards at 320 x 720: original illustrations, simplified watercolours, minimal woodblock prints and a layered animated woodblock set. Static landscape woodblock artwork at 1280 x 720 is available for weather dialogs. Each set covers Kodi weather codes 0-47 and na. Animated artwork uses static plates and up to five single-frame PNGs per effect.

extension.summary: Blurred backgrounds and online ratings for Arctic Fuse 3 without TMDb Helper
extension.description: Makes the blurred and rounded background images Arctic Fuse 3 shows behind its windows and dialogs: the focused item's fanart (cycling its extra fanarts when the skin asks), and the plain background on demand. Runs only while Arctic Fuse 3 is the active skin with blur switched on. With an MDBList and/or OMDb API key in the skin settings it also looks up the focused item's ratings (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd, Trakt, MAL, MDBList); that part is ported from adamsbuilds' script.shortfuse.helper (GPL-3).
